card.name: Digit 4 in 1840s years
card.fires_on: Mostly the digit 4 in the tens place of a year in the 1840s (1846, 1848, 1849) in US and Canadian history text. It also fires weakly on a few other spots in historical phrases.

modes.label: Tens digit of 1840s years
modes.description: The digit 4 right after '18' in a year from the 1840s, in historical narrative.
modes.example: Born a slave in Maryland in 1820, Harriet Tubman escaped to Philadelphia in 18<<4>>9, but returned to Maryland shortly after

modes.label: Other historical phrases
modes.description: Scattered words inside fixed historical titles or quotes, such as Board of Special Inquiry or Britannica.
